- Preprocess: remove all spaces from the input string to simplify parsing.
- Iterate characters, maintaining a depth counter and a current buffer; append each char to the buffer, increment on '(' and decrement on ')'; when depth returns to zero, finalize the current buffer as a group and reset it.
- Collect finalized groups in order and return the list; handle empty input by returning an empty list and assume input is balanced per spec.
